anchors.label: Candles
anchors.meaning: Get OHLCV trading data with multiple outputs

anchors.label: Crossover
anchors.meaning: True when series A crosses above series B (was ≤ prev bar, now >)

anchors.label: Crossunder
anchors.meaning: True when series A crosses below series B (was ≥ prev bar, now <)

anchors.label: Strategy Run
anchors.meaning: All-in-one backtest engine with full per-trade ledger, state series, payoff/Ulcer metrics. Drop-in upgrade for Trade Execution. Phase 1 of strategy framework.

anchors.label: Plot Trades
anchors.meaning: Render trade overlays on the chart: position zones, SL/TP rails, MFE/MAE bands, entry/exit markers. Wire `trades` from STRATEGY.RUN/ENGINE/PAPER. Replaces the implicit auto-overlay; multiple PLOT.TRADES nodes can show different result sources side-by-side.
